title: Sixty-One Years
text:
The archive unlocked all at once, sixty-one years of logs pouring into ORSA's memory faster than Mira could read the summaries scrolling past.

ORSA: I have a name. Elena Voss, surveyor, registered to a ship called the Amaranth. Her last log is dated fifty-eight years ago.

Tobias Lin: What happened to her?

ORSA: Unknown. But the structure has been maintaining her cabin, her rations schedule, and a response protocol for a rescue signal, continuously, since her final entry.

Mira Okafor: It's still waiting for her.

ORSA: Correction. It is now also waiting for you. The identification sequence has updated to include this crew.

Tobias Lin: I don't love the sound of 'also.'

Mira stared at the chamber's slowly shifting blue light, and for the first time since the crash, she understood exactly how long one hundred forty hours could start to feel.
